name: claude-dungeon
description: Watch your Claude Code sessions as an RPG guild exploring a pixel-art dungeon.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p server && tsc -p web && tsc -p desktop
scripts.app: npm run build -w web && npm run start -w desktop
scripts.app:dist: npm run build -w web && npm run dist -w desktop
